description: This file defines a command class for generating Doctrine proxy classes within a specific HR management system project. It extends a console command class, utilizes Doctrine ORM setup, and integrates with project-specific configuration to generate proxy classes for entities in plugin paths.

classes.name: GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand
classes.description: A console command class responsible for generating Doctrine ORM proxy classes based on project plugin entity paths.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name string used to invoke this command in CLI.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that sets up ORM configuration, retrieves plugin entity paths, and generates proxy classes.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Collects and returns filesystem paths to plugin entity directories based on configuration.
